value.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for 1,000x1,000x1,000x1,000 dynamic scenario generation, stakeholder boundary gating and Task/Task-Object digestion
value.lets_workers: Generate 1,000 Gaia2-style dynamic situations across 25 public-good and technical domains, pair them with 1,000 decomposition and compute strategies, 1,000 operator harness personas and 1,000 multi-position stakeholders, evaluate 1,000-cell Latin-hypercube sweeps or O(1) lookups across 10^12 tuples, and digest approved trajectories into SHA-256-pinned candidate Tasks and Task Objects.

flow.when: Materialize or extend the 1,000 environments, 1,000 methods, 1,000 personas and 1,000 stakeholders.
Run a 1,000-cell 4D Latin-hypercube sweep or bounded slice and apply stakeholder block and lane-partition gates.
Rank and hash approved trajectories into candidate Tasks (verbs) and Task Objects (nouns) with explicit human_only boundaries.

value.worked_example: Synthetic 3-tuple episode bundle recomputed in test_scenario_matrix.py: blocks unsplit cloud inference on ENV-0001 offline shelter PII, partitions ENV-0002 mixed shelter intake into private local and public donor lanes, and approves ENV-0084 public municipal budget audit under verify-cascade.

dimension_basis.reason: Tessera requires these axes, so each is set to its lowest value and the tier is unverified. No quality is claimed. Replace them only with measured values and the evidence that produced them.

value.title: Guardrail: block cloud compute tiers on offline airgap or unsplit high-PII situations
value.category_reason: Prevents raw sensitive intake, clinical or legal records from crossing into external model endpoints.

value.how_it_is_checked: evaluate_and_digest_episode checks connectivity, sensitivity and privacy_boundary first and emits verdict blocked.

value.category_reason: Tested Python standard-library package pinned by path, file count and digest.
value.name: Meta ARE scenario matrix
value.runtime: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only, with optional worker llm_extender callback.
does: Generates 1,000 indexed environments, 1,000 methods, 1,000 operator personas and 1,000 stakeholders deterministically.
Evaluates 1,000-cell 4D Latin-hypercube sweeps covering every index 0001..1000 on all 4 axes and resolves arbitrary tuples in [0, 10^12 - 1] in O(1).
Applies stakeholder privacy, offline, latency and two-step review gates and digests approved episodes into SHA-256-hashed candidate Tasks and Task Objects.
does_not: Enqueue tasks automatically, widen visibility beyond surface_only or claim synthetic sweeps are field deployments.
